jobs.name: p1_dome
jobs.prompt: A full-bleed illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, with no border, no margin and no paper edge. A dark oil sketch for a book plate, painted loosely on a toned ground over a bold brush-ink drawing whose dark lines show through on the main contours: thick paint where the light falls, thin transparent dark glazes in the shadows, visible brush marks, strong chiaroscuro, realistic proportions, grim and serious. Night, two thousand years ago. Seen from high on the rim of a vast deep cut in a hillside, looking steeply down into it. In the foreground at the top left, two ancient legionaries seen from behind, in crested bronze helmets with cheek guards and rust-red cloaks over banded armor, hold torches high. From them a long column of legionaries with torches winds down a narrow path along the cut's steep wall, the figures growing smaller and smaller as they go down into the dark; one carries a standard on a pole. Far below, the cut's whole floor is the top of something vast: one broad pale dome of smooth gray-white hide with faint broad ridges across it, far wider than the cut, its sides running in under the rock walls on both sides, so that only the top of its back shows above the earth. The tiny torches at the bottom of the path show how enormous it is. It is dim, lit only by the torches. Torch smoke drifts and sparks fall into the dark. The orange torchlight is the only strong color; everything else is night.
